notes.title: Minor Update Patch 1.06
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

New Features:

 New Ascension Upgrade nad type of upgrade (in the blue panel).
 Added more levels to the Ascension % Boost upgrade to make it easier to get all planets to level 1000. Now each level grants more Galaxy Points.
 Added a counter for the total number of rocks destroyed for the achievement.


Improvements:

 Now you can see the current total ascension points to spend in the ascension tree view.
 Upgrades in the blue panel are now more affordable.
 Adjusted the prices of some ascension upgrades for better balance.


Fixes:

 Fixed the issue where rocks appeared behind the cash panel; they now appear in front.


Sorry for the delay in the patch; due to various reasons, it took longer than expected. I will continue improving and adding new content! 🪐🚀

notes.title: Minor Update Patch 1.05
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

New Features:

 Automaton Purchase: You can now purchase all available automation aliens with a single click.
 Speed Upgrade Purchase: You can now buy all speed upgrades for automation aliens with a single click.


Improvements:

 Galactic Points Display: Galactic points are now displayed with decimals instead of rounding.
 Total Planet Production Display: The total production per second for all planets is now displayed.


Fixes:

 Cosmic Sage Achievement: Fixed the issue with the COSMIC SAGE achievement, which now unlocks correctly.

notes.title: Minor Update Patch 1.04
notes.notes:
Next Patch Updates:

 The prices of ascension upgrades are now cheaper.
 You unlock the next ascension level when you buy 1 level of the previous one (except when more than one type of ascension is required to unlock the next one).
 After reaching one million ascension points, you continue to gain points incrementally without needing to reach 10% for the next level.
 Increased the prices of automation speed upgrades.

notes.title: Minor Update Patch 1.03
notes.notes:
Patch Updates:


 Added a visualization of the ascension tree, allowing to view it before making an ascension.
 Fixed the production per second calculation for upgrades on all planets.

notes.title: Minor Update Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

New Features:

 Rock Sounds: Added rock sounds when they spawn (slightly reduced the spawn time).
 Next Production Tooltip: The upgrades tooltip now shows you the next production per second.


Improvements:

 AFK Ascension Descriptions: Modified the description of AFK ascension.
 Scrollbar Reset: Scrollbar now resets to the default position when opening the Automata menu.
 Automatic Planet Activation: When you buy an automaton, the planet will automatically activate its generation.
 Right-Click Buy Quantity: Right-click now decreases the buyer quantity.
 Tooltip Refresh: Tooltips refresh when information changes.
 Minerals Display: You can now see your minerals when the Automata panel is open.


Fixes:

 Ascension Points Decimals: Removed unnecessary decimals from Ascension Points.

notes.title: Minor Update Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

New Features:

 Next Buy Button: Implemented a "Next Buy" button for easier purchasing of the next item in sequence.
 Brazilian and Latin Spanish Languages: Added support for Brazilian Portuguese and Latin American Spanish languages.

 
Improvements:

 Minerals Per Second:  Now, all planets indicate the minerals generated per second.
 Buy 10 Upgrades Quantity Changed:  The upgrade quantity options have been updated to x1, x50, x100, NEXT, and MAX.
 Minimum 1 Upgrade:  Now, there is always a minimum of 1 upgrade available to buy, regardless of your current cash.


Fixes:

 Tooltip:  Fixed the issue where the tooltip would remain visible when you shift-tab and exit the game. Now, the tooltip disappears correctly.
